purpose: Cool-region palette trials + the CANDIDATE re-freeze they support. The frozen palette has essentially no cool half — the five approved trials it was fitted over are warm/green — so these trials ask whether it should be re-fitted over a broadened source set; this file is their provenance.
status: CANDIDATE — nothing here is approved and nothing is promoted. data/palette.json is FROZEN and UNTOUCHED.
_readme: Regenerate with `npx tsx tools/palette/build-manifest-palette.ts`. Rows are read back from assets/raw/palette-trials/_run{1,2}.json; every sha256 is computed from the bytes on disk. tools/comfy/manifest.json is a concurrent workflow's file — these rows do NOT merge into it, because none of these images is a shipped asset.
_seedRule: Every row uses seed 42, the validated trial seed — the same seed every gate-B0 trial used. `manifestDerivedSeed` records what tools/comfy/manifest.json would use for the corresponding SHIPPED row, so the two are never confused. G5 is untouched: no approved asset is regenerated here, and no row here is approved.

_generationCount.g13: Under the 20-item threshold, so build-doc G13's credit estimate + --confirm gate does not apply.

_subjectProvenance: Round-1 subjects are the `prompt` field of the named `tools/comfy/manifest.json` row, VERBATIM — that file is the G2-gated transcription of bible §4 (species) and §6 (towns), so the trial prompt is the exact string B3/B4 will submit for that asset. Round-2 subjects vary ONLY the anatomy clause and the view clause, for the reasons recorded per row.

candidate.method: srgb / equal per-image, k-means++ seeded 42 — the gate-B0 method with a broadened INPUT

classEqual.method: srgb / class-equal — same source set, each ASSET CLASS given an equal vote
classEqual.why: Measured secondary option. Over 19 images "equal per image" no longer delivers the thing it was chosen for at B0 ("every asset class gets an equal vote"), because creature-battle now holds 12 images and overworld-character holds 1.
